t: 阿基泰纳的埃莉诺与路易王子(后为法国国王路易七世)在波尔多圣安德雷大教堂结婚.
te: Eleanor of Aquitaine marries Prince Louis, later King Louis VII of France, at the Cathedral of Saint-André in Bordeaux.
